meta.title: Removing a PR line from a live event returns its quantity after the deletion job
gaps: No setup recipe creates a published event with two PR lines.
No operation expresses deleting one line from a live event or waiting for a deletion job bounded to 60 seconds.
No available read-back field verifies a removed line's PR quantity returning to open or an activity-log entry saying "deleted from event".
The available line-deletion library case covers only deletion of the sole line and expects rejection, so it does not match this case.
